title: Diameter of Binary Tree
microsoftNote: Height vs diameter — the return value to the parent is height, the answer is a side effect.
statement:
The diameter is the length of the longest path between any two nodes, measured in **edges**. It may or may not pass through the root.

Trees are given as level-order arrays (`null` for missing children).
constraints: The number of nodes is in [0, 10^4].
editorial: For each node, diameter candidate = leftHeight + rightHeight. Recurse heights. Keep a global max.
